stubs.service: Connectivity/latency ping to https://caravane.digital/favicon.ico (the main-menu "CRVN xx ms" badge, src/utils/network.ts). This is the only outside request the web build makes.
stubs.how: out/aurora-seed-loader.js wraps window.fetch and sends any caravane.digital request to /stubs/caravane/favicon.ico, a local copy of the app icon served with the static build, so the badge shows a real local round-trip time. The app source is unchanged.

stubs.service: In-game online services: TrustMail mail, Messages, Browser websites (aurora.edu, techblog.com, hackwithjack.org, securebank.com, trustmail.com), WiFi
stubs.how: No stub needed. These are simulated inside the app (MailService/MessagesService keep their data in localStorage, and the websites are React components), so there are no API keys or backends. The optional .env.example variables keep their defaults. Electron's binary download was skipped (ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD=1) because only the web build is used.

stubs.service: Seed data delivery (an established player's save game)
stubs.how: out/seed.json is a localStorage dump in the same format as DevCenter's "Import Storage". out/aurora-seed-loader.js, added to the built index.html <head> before the app bundle, copies it into localStorage on the first visit, but only when the browser has no Aurora save (no os_filesystem key and no sys_seed_applied flag). The app's source code is unchanged. A second script, out/aurora-autopilot.js, clicks through the game's splash, main menu and login (see notes) so the page opens on the desktop; ?intro disables it.

notes:
Setup: Node 24.11.1 pinned in mise.toml (the repo's .nvmrc says 24 and engines says >=24). Run .ui-capture/build.sh, which does: npm ci, then the repo's own `npm run build` (tsc + vite build), copies dist/ to .ui-capture/out, adds the seed loader, then runs the seed generator and .ui-capture/seed/finalize.mjs. The seed generator (.ui-capture/seed/generate.seed.tsx with data in seed/data.ts) runs under the app's own vitest/jsdom setup and replays about six months of use through the app's own code: AppProvider and FileSystemProvider (the same addUser/addUserToGroup/setOnboardingComplete calls Onboarding.tsx makes), plus createDirectory/createFile/moveToTrash, MailService and MessagesService. It moves the clock with vi.setSystemTime, so files, mails and messages have real dates between 2026-05-22 (install) and 2026-11-17. finalize.mjs maps asset URLs to the hashed files in the production build.

What the entry URL shows: the game always opens on a 'CLICK TO START' splash, followed by the main menu, a boot log and the login screen. On its own that leaves the page nearly blank (only the start button). out/aurora-autopilot.js, loaded right after the seed loader, therefore performs the returning player's own steps through the real UI: click Initialize System, skip the logo, choose Continue (enabled because a save exists), wait for the boot log, then pick Mira Calloway and log in with her password from the users DB. After about 6–8 s the page is the logged-in desktop (Aurora wallpaper, fuchsia accent, WiFi 'Calloway-5G'), with the saved window session restored: a Finder window and the Mail app open on the seeded inbox. Add ?intro (e.g. /?intro) to turn the autopilot off and click through by hand: Continue, then Mira Calloway, password nightowl42 (hint: 'bird that stays up late'; root password: admin).

Data: player Mira Calloway, an InfoSec student at Aurora University who takes freelance pentest jobs. About 60 files under /home/mira: Documents/{Notes, University course folders, Freelance client folders with scopes/findings/invoices, CTF writeups, Finance csv}, Projects/{portscan-lite, dotfiles, wifi-survey}, Desktop scratch files, Downloads, Pictures (4 photos plus a screenshot), Music (2 tracks), one item in Trash, and .bash_history. Mail (TrustMail account mira.calloway@trustmail.com / Tr0ub4dor&3; the app logs in automatically via ~/.Config/mail.json): 53 emails covering client threads, a professor, the registrar, family, sent replies and newsletters (TechBlog, HackWithJack, SecureBank, Aurora University), mixing read/unread, starred, archived and trashed, with one attachment. Messages (logs in automatically as 'mira'): 84 messages with 7 contacts (devon, sasha, nana, jack_hwj, rosa.hollowpine, priya, theo_ta), several unread, 2 starred. Calendar: about 120 events from June to December 2026, including recurring classes in a custom 'University' category, client work, CTFs, social, family and deadlines (e.g. the Hollow Pine on-site visit on Nov 20 and a proposal due Nov 24). Installed via the App Store (FileSystemProvider.installApp): Notepad, Messages, Calendar, Music, Photos. The Dock shows Finder/Browser/Mail plus Terminal/Settings; the others are in the Dock's overflow (grid) menu, which is how the app lays out more than 3 user apps. Also seeded: a saved window session (Finder + Mail), Notepad with 3 open tabs (one with unsaved edits), Browser history and bookmarks, the notification center, terminal input history, and known WiFi networks.

Main areas: Desktop and Dock, the Finder file manager, Terminal, Browser (in-game sites such as aurora.edu, techblog.com, hackwithjack.org, securebank.com and trustmail.com), Mail, Messages, Calendar, Notepad, Photos, Music, Settings, DevCenter and the App Store. Clearing site data, or choosing 'New Game' and then reloading with sys_seed_applied removed, brings the seed back. Verification: Chrome cannot start inside this sandbox, so .ui-capture/seed/smoke.check.tsx renders the real <App/> in jsdom at 1440x900 with out/seed.json loaded, runs the shipped out/aurora-autopilot.js and checks the stages: intro, then the menu (~1.5 s), the login screen (~6 s) and the desktop (~6.4 s), where the seeded Desktop files, the Finder window and the Mail inbox are visible. Run it with: npx vitest run --config .ui-capture/seed/vitest.seed.config.ts smoke.
